scope: Descriptive fixed-policy target-inset intervention after the observed same-checkpoint numerical repeatability failure. No training or dynamics guarantee.
intervention: Original bounded absolute controller target is clamped to joint bounds inset by the declared margin. Proposal is post-original-hard-limit target, not a pre-limit raw proposal. Fixed physical joint ranges and task thresholds are unchanged.
initialization: Original evaluator zero-process/apply/write/forward/sense completes first. Filter begins only at the first real env.step. Full t0 qpos/qvel/ctrl and public physical fields must match across all9 jobs.

target_log.semantics: Interval k drives state k to state k+1; raw rollout joint_target_rad[1:] must equal actual executed controls in native FP32.

zero_margin_checks: same FP32 clamp path, no zero shortcut
original proposal equals filtered execution bitwise
filtered target equals runtime cache and actual ctrl bitwise
initial previous target equals actual t0ctrl
all_margin_checks: inner bounds equal original bounds plus/minus margin in native FP32
cache and actual readback equal filtered target
original EMA residual remains bitwise unchanged by filtering
initial_ctrl[position_ctrl_ids] matches u_prev and initial cached target in joint order
all original task metrics independently recomputed without changed thresholds
exact full initial physical state across all9 jobs
endpoints: every frozen task gate and complete3s task_success
actual20-joint limit excess and peak joint/time
solver-active real hand-object contact counts, normals and measured force diagnostics
clamp component and control-tick trigger fractions, per-joint counts and command-change magnitude
evaluator, child-supervisor and whole-driver cost scopes separately
contrasts: Retain all3 blocks for each margin. Compare5minus0 and20minus0 descriptively within predeclared blocks, with mean/median/min/max only. Shared block does not imply identical realized numerical noise or common action trajectories after feedback.
missingness: Running, not-run, engineering-censored or missing/invalid inputs remain PENDING/NOT_RUN/INVALID with task_success=null; never infer failure or zero. Condition pass count unavailable if any of its three jobs is invalid.
limits: Single checkpoint/reference/object/initial condition, previously observed fresh-process variation, three observations per condition, no original ego or hardware safety/generalization claim. Target insets do not establish actuator-only braking or a hard state constraint.
